postgres_each_fix.diagnosis: Test choreography exhausted the two-connection isolated pool: locker and writer retain both connections, while lock polling through db attempts a third acquisition. The default five-second acquisition timeout prevents the observer from releasing the locked row.
postgres_each_fix.fix: Poll pg_blocking_pids on the existing locker transaction; it is idle while holding the row lock. Release only after observing the actual writer lock wait. Preserve complete-candidate overflow rejection before callbacks and unchanged-row assertions for both update and delete.
postgres_each_fix.runtime_audit: planEach still selects limit+1 candidates in primary-key order with waiting LockUpdate; eachCandidates rejects overflow before writeEach invokes drafts or lifecycle callbacks. No runtime change warranted by this failure.
postgres_each_fix.verification: PostgreSQL sources compile and vet; live two-transaction execution remains for the lead. Patch contains only the test fix relative to 05b830c.
